_comment: First-principles build-around support metadata for the draft-pool support metric. Generated by per-card analysis of printed text (see scripts/pool-metrics.mjs). needs[] = themes this card is a build-around payoff for, each with a demand tier 1/2/3; supports[] = themes this card provides support for. Cards that are neither are omitted. Keyed by each card's cards_v2 id UUID; the name field is informational and refreshed from the current card name.
